seoTitle: Video Production & Event Filming Cambridge | FilmEditRun
seoDescription: Independent corporate video production and multi-camera event filming across University of Cambridge Colleges, Cambridge Science Park & tech hubs. Fast local turnaround.
heroSubtitle: On-location filming for Cambridge’s technology, science, and academic leaders. We capture conferences, research stories, and executive interviews with calm focus and technical precision.
expertiseHeading: Filming Across Cambridge’s Research & Innovation Hubs
expertiseDescription: Whether documenting academic symposia in historic college settings or profiling breakthrough technologies on the science parks, we ensure your speakers, researchers, and venue teams experience a calm, well-planned production with minimal demand on their time.
cardBody: Cambridge innovation demands technical understanding without dry presentation. Working directly with our lead filmmakers, you get articulate on-camera interviews, clear sound in challenging rooms, and polished films that resonate with global partners and investors.

faqs.question: How do you help executives, scientists, and non-actors feel confident on camera?
faqs.answer: We adapt to your team: conducting relaxed conversational interviews to draw out natural authority, or providing on-camera teleprompters so leadership and technical teams can deliver approved, scripted messaging with complete confidence.

faqs.question: Can you align the films with our brand guidelines and technical assets?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work directly with your brand guidelines, typography, and colour palettes. From on-brand lower thirds and motion graphics to high-resolution slide integration, every deliverable is built to sit natively within your corporate identity.

faqs.question: How does the review and sign-off process work with multiple stakeholders?
faqs.answer: We share draft cuts via timecoded, frame-accurate review links. Communications leads, scientific advisors, and project stakeholders can leave precise feedback directly on the timeline, eliminating confusing email chains and streamlining final sign-off.

bottomCtaHeading: Planning a shoot or event in *Cambridge?*
bottomCtaBody: Calm, low-profile filming configured around your venue and schedule, from historic college halls to science park campuses.
